video.title: FULLTANK MONDAY: You Don’t Have To Earn God’s Love
video.description:
You don't have to perform, earn, or prove anything to be accepted by God, because His love is a free gift given to you as His child. Unlike the world, which demands report cards, bank accounts, and constant proof of your worth before offering approval, God embraces you right where you are in your mess and imperfection. 

#FULLTANKwithBroBo #FULLTANKwithBroBo2026 #BoSanchez #YouDontHaveToEarnGodsLove #UnconditionalGrace #IdentityInChrist #FaithInAction #SpiritualMaturity #TrulyRichMindset #GodIsAFather #Grace

---
PS. Are You A Parent?
Are you thinking about Homeschooling for your kids?
My wife and I have homeschooled our two boys.
Looking back, it’s one of the BEST decisions we’ve ever made.
It gave us the space to pass on our values.
It also gave them space to explore their passions and interests.
If you want to know more about homeschooling and to find out if it is for your kids, check out this link: www.facebook.com/CFAHomeschool or cfa.edu.ph
